summary: Psyence Biomedical Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing the initiation of patient dosing in a Phase IIb clinical trial of NPX-5 (psilocybin) for adjustment disorder in palliative care. This is a routine clinical milestone disclosure for a biopharmaceutical company, not a special situation event. No deal terms, price, premium, or merger-related activity are present. The filing is an ordinary update on operational progress, lacking any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situations trigger.
